criteria.text: The contract list names records, their owner files and their current prompt and test users.
Changing a used shared record marks every Story using it stale since its last actual check.
A different record in the same file leaves an unrelated Story in the same batch current.
No actual check baseline is shown as not checked, and a legacy baseline is shown as unavailable.
Lint and Try do not replace an actual check baseline.
Listing contracts makes no runtime call and changes no source or history.

cases.given: Markdown descriptive section, heading with spaces, JSON schema node, unused record; two prompt users and one seeded test
cases.required_observation: list canonical targets, owner files, exact users and Stories; descriptive section omitted; unused record has no users

cases.given: actual Check for Stories A and B using record agent; edit agent; include a nested use
cases.required_observation: agent changed; A and B stale; check baseline remains its submitted value

cases.given: A uses agent, B uses ticket in one Markdown file; both checked in one batch; edit agent only
cases.required_observation: A stale; B current; unrelated raw record bytes neither uploaded nor part of B fingerprint

cases.given: one Story never checked; one historical receipt has no reference snapshots
cases.required_observation: not checked and baseline unavailable respectively; no invented changed record

cases.given: actual Check snapshot old; edit record; complete lint and Try; then an evaluated Check
cases.required_observation: lint/Try leave old baseline and stale status; later actual Check advances only its Story

cases.given: offline local catalog/history with auth/fetch/slot/write spies
cases.required_observation: all external and write counts 0; finite local output
